title: Unlock Typographic Brilliance: Master CSS 'font-feature-settings' for Elite UI & Web Font UX
tweet: Elevate your web typography! Discover how CSS 'font-feature-settings' unlocks hidden OpenType features like ligatures & small caps for stunning UI & enhanced UX. #CSSTypography #WebDesign #UIUX
tip: Leverage CSS 'font-feature-settings' to enable sophisticated OpenType features like standard ligatures ('liga'), discretionary ligatures ('dlig'), kerning ('kern'), or specific numeral styles ('onum' for oldstyle numbers) to significantly improve text aesthetics and readability. This is particularly effective with high-quality web fonts that include these features.
